$comment: J-7 T-12 — the SHOTS-PRESENT contract (structural, operator grill J-5/J-6 retro).
Per-journey-under-work, the paired legacy<->AlpenFlight views the proof gallery
page is EXPECTED to carry. The pre-deploy `[shots-present]` guard in
proof-gallery-links.spec.ts reads this + the staged screenshots.json and FAILS
if an `expected` <side>:<view> is absent from the stage — replacing the old
silent add_shot/add_pair drop (a partial-red capture could quietly ship a thin
page while the generator stayed green). Mirrors the MapperBindingContract
KNOWN_UNBOUND allowlist pattern: a shot that is legitimately deferred goes in
`pending` (tolerated-absent, surfaced) until it lands; an `expected` shot is
load-bearing and its absence reds the journey's proof job.
Keys: <side>:<view>, side in {legacy, alpenflight}. The view + side MUST match
the journey's add_shot/add_pair declarations in ci.yml (per-push) and
alpenflight-proof-fanout.yml (nightly) so the guard checks the SAME entries the
gallery renders. Greenfield AlpenFlight-only views have no `legacy:` peer.
A journey absent from this file is NOT guarded (no enforced shots) — add a
journey here when its proof page should carry paired shots.
